description: MATLAB works with numbers, rows and grids of data. A grid of numbers is called a matrix. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Use MATLAB. Paste one example into the Command Window, or save it as a .m script and run the script. A MATLAB licence may be required.
versionNote: Examples use MATLAB R2020b or later and basic built-in commands.
whatYouWillLearn: Make an evenly spaced row with MATLAB
learningObjectives: Read a grid cell with MATLAB
